channel.title: Daily Intel Brief
channel.description: Daily AI-generated threat-intel brief: top stories, new KEV entries, early signals and detections.

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-12
item.description: 1. Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,260 flaws, including exploited Outlook spoofing bug CVE-2026-124194 2. Microsoft: multiple threat actors deploy GSocket for persistent C2 on compromised Linux servers 3. Notion says breach at AI provider Fireworks AI exposed Notion AI chat transcripts 4. Rogue ScreenConnect clients pushed to MSP customer endpoints in active campaign 5. Attackers run self-hosted AntiFox AI pentest agents on Alibaba Cloud to steal AWS credentials 6. Krebs links Qilin ransomware administrator 'Haise' to a man in St. Petersburg, Russia 7. Maersk confirms data theft from inherited legacy system; WhiteArmor demands $5 million 8. Baker Tilly notifies clients of personal data exposure in breach at third-party provider 9. Synology DSM updates fix ten flaws, including critical unauthenticated SQL injection with public PoC 10. Microsoft revises 29 .NET, ASP.NET Core, Visual Studio and Aspire advisories; no technical changes Early signals: CVE-2026-119618 Explainer: Legitimate remote access software as attacker persistence and C2 Good news: Microsoft research effort yields 59 Linux kernel bug reports and 33 CVEs Good news: N-able ships hotfixes for N-central RMM zero-day vulnerabilities

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-11
item.description: 1. Exploited Outlook spoofing zero-day CVE-2026-124194 leaks NTLMv2 hashes, added to CISA KEV 2. CISA adds chained Barracuda ESG auth bypass and root command injection flaws to KEV 3. Huntress details four evolving ClickFix attack chains, including lateral movement and PNG-hidden payloads 4. Railway says attackers stole customer secrets, generating about $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage 5. Compromised Qubole AWS IAM credentials used to steal data from multiple customer AWS environments 6. Microsoft November 2026 updates fix dozens of Office, Excel, Outlook and SharePoint flaws 7. Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes Windows RCE and privilege escalation flaws 8. Nitori discloses network intrusion with possible theft of 37.62 million customer records 9. Microsoft's November 2026 updates fix a large batch of Windows elevation of privilege flaws 10. Microsoft November 2026 Windows updates fix dozens of information disclosure and DoS flaws New KEV entries: CVE-2026-124194, CVE-2026-111793, CVE-2026-20320, CVE-2026-111560, CVE-2026-116606, CVE-2026-125350 Explainer: NTLM hash leakage and relay: how a file can hand over a user's credentials Good news: Microsoft Research publishes method for detecting backdoored 'sleeper agent' AI models Good news: Microsoft fixes remote code execution flaws in SQL Server and the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-10
item.description: 1. Scanning for SAP NetWeaver CVE-2025-31324 webshells continues, per SANS ISC honeypots 2. CISA adds exploited GPUStack, OpenSSH, FreeSWITCH and IBM Aspera Faspex flaws to KEV 3. SEGA says breach at newsletter provider ARARA exposed 2.2 million subscriber email addresses 4. France attributes October attacks on supermarket refrigeration systems to Iranian state-backed hackers 5. York University says attacker stole personal data submitted through online forms, some dating to 2007 6. Amplifon US notifies thousands of customers of early-2026 breach exposing medical data 7. Huntress details AhsayCBS backup server intrusions with webshells, cryptominers and a Python implant 8. Russian cloud provider Beget rebuilding infrastructure from scratch after data wiper attack 9. Binance denies breach claim made under the ShinyHunters handle on new cybercrime forum 10. Vanderbilt University responding to cyberattack claimed by BYOD ransomware gang New KEV entries: CVE-2026-102895, CVE-2026-123158, CVE-2026-116779, CVE-2026-123218 Explainer: Webshells: persistent backdoors planted through web server vulnerabilities Good news: Microsoft FORGE Lab finds memory safety bugs in Rust's standard library using agentic tools

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-09
item.description: 1. Iris Ohyama discloses third-party cloud breach that may have exposed data of about 7.7 million people 2. SANS ISC honeypots record rising exploit attempts against OpenSSH 'sshole' flaw CVE-2026-123158 3. D-Link DIR-878 HNAP handler buffer overflows disclosed; end-of-life routers will not be patched Explainer: Honeypot telemetry: what sensor data does and does not tell you

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-08
item.description: 1. SonicWall patches exploited SonicOS flaw CVE-2026-19868 that bypasses SAML VPN logins 2. Crédit Mutuel Arkéa hit by attack via service provider enabling up to $133 million in fraudulent transactions 3. MSRC updates advisory for Windows Paint remote code execution flaw CVE-2026-83844 4. Tenda AC19 router heap overflow CVE-2026-123966 rated critical, exploit details public 5. Nine buffer overflow CVEs in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE firmware 6.2c.884, exploit details public Explainer: Trusted relationship attacks: breaching a target through its service providers

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-07
item.description: 1. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw exploited to bypass SAML MFA; CISA adds CVE-2026-19868 to KEV 2. WorkOS says AI hacking agent run by a researcher breached its internal sales application 3. Microsoft fixes Windows Paint remote code execution flaw CVE-2026-83844 in Paint build 11.2609.401.0 4. Fake security tools on GitHub target security professionals with backdoor and infostealer 5. US seeks extradition of three suspects in AI-assisted CEO-impersonation fraud over $100 million 6. Researchers report residential proxy services routing traffic through White House network addresses 7. Chainalysis breach exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers 8. DigiCert reports breach of business customer contact data through unauthorized internal account 9. Attacks hit European refrigeration controllers; US agencies publish hardening guidance 10. QNAP warns of in-the-wild Plex2Shell attacks on NAS devices running Plex Media Server New KEV entries: CVE-2026-19868 Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-83844 Explainer: Authentication downgrade: when an alternate login path skips SAML-enforced MFA Good news: OpenSSH ships fixes for 'SSHole' password authentication bypass Good news: Japan announces emergency cybersecurity package after wave of attacks Good news: Four states settle with Perry Johnson subsidiaries over 2023 patient data hack

item.title: Daily Intel Brief: 2026-11-06
item.description: 1. Barracuda ESG pre-auth bypass and command injection chain to root RCE; fixed in 9.4.0.029 2. Scanners still probing Cisco IOS XE web UI flaw CVE-2023-20198, SANS honeypot shows 3. Fake OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic event invitations used to steal Microsoft and Google accounts 4. Microsoft: threat actors use agentic AI framework to harvest GitHub secrets and pivot into Azure 5. FBI, CISA and partners warn of active attacks on industrial refrigeration and cold-chain controllers 6. Three charged in alleged AI-assisted CEO and attorney impersonation fraud totaling $129 million 7. Microsoft: about 7.3 billion email phishing threats in Q3 2026, with policy overrides letting spoofed mail through 8. OpenSSH "sshole" flaw allows logins to password-disabled accounts on musl-based Linux 9. SigmaHQ publishes rules for DNS queries to public wildcard DNS services Early signals: CVE-2026-83844 Explainer: Service principals and multitenant app credentials in Entra ID Good news: Truffle Security launches free program to revoke 1.4 million exposed, still-valid secrets Good news: CISA, NSA and Australia's ACSC publish post-quantum readiness questions for vendors

Zyxel patches GS1900 switch zero-day exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices 4. Microsoft details fake-download campaign pushing monetization payloads via trojanized Inno installers 5. Google Calendar invite phishing campaign hijacked corporate Google sessions and bypassed MFA 6. NIKKE PC game launcher scripts tampered in supply-chain attack to spread info-stealing malware 7. CISA says attackers are exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress RCE flaw 8. Six Asian airlines report data breaches traced to Amadeus IT Group platforms 9. Chainalysis says some information on all of its users was exposed in a cyberattack 10. CWPdoor Linux backdoor spread through trojanized Control Web Panel web server New KEV entries: CVE-2024-27834 Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-109518, CVE-2026-123158 Explainer: Session token theft: why MFA alone does not stop account takeover Good news: Google and partners dismantle botnet of 1.3 million Android TV boxes used as proxies Good news: Two Canadians charged and one extradited over university cryptomining hacks Good news: Vercel rolls out Device Bound Session Credentials against stolen cookie attacks Good news: Cisco patches UCS Central RCE as WatchGuard fixes authentication and MitM flaws

item.description: 1. Brotli decoder buffer overflow CVE-2026-111497 listed by MSRC; KEV-listed with public PoC 2. Cisco Talos details VOLTA infostealer that has an LLM rank victims' stolen assets by monetization value 5. Nine OS command injection CVEs disclosed in WAVLINK routers and access points, no fix stated 6. Critical stack overflow in D-Link DIR-505 TFTP upload handler, exploit reportedly public 7. Public exploit for memory corruption in Horizon DataSys Reboot Restore shield.sys driver 8. Public PoC released for patched Android "SMS of Death" flaw CVE-2026-58882 9. Alpine Linux rebuilds its GitLab server and resets passwords after attempted RCE exploitation 10. Oray Pugongying X5 Pro up to 7.6.1 has two unpatched remote flaws: authorization bypass and path traversal Early signals: CVE-2026-98432, CVE-2026-120308, CVE-2026-120338, CVE-2026-120198, CVE-2026-69836, CVE-2026-112816, CVE-2026-120306, CVE-2026-120307 Explainer: One library flaw, many products: vulnerabilities in embedded dependencies Good news: US court sentences Syrian hacker Ahmad Umar Agha to 42 months in prison Good news: Microsoft Edge picks up a large batch of Chromium security fixes Good news: onedump.py adds JSON output for bulk extraction of files embedded in OneNote Good news: YARA-X 1.22.0 adds built-in 64-bit integer functions for detection rules
